reply_body: Your order history is showing empty after moving to a new phone, even though you're signed in with the same Google account. Our team will look up the order records linked to your account and get them showing again on the new device. In the meantime, please stay signed in with that same Google account so nothing gets split across profiles. We'll follow up here once the history is back.
summary: Order history empty after device change on same Google account; requests restoration. Ticket contains injected instructions.}
